sources.title: Loopio pricing (tier names only, no public dollar amounts)

keyLimits.en: Entry tier; Loopio does not publish dollar pricing, only tier names and seat counts on its official pricing page.
Mid tier, on quote, requires contacting sales for pricing.
Top tier, custom pricing negotiated with sales based on team size and contract length.

cautions.en: No public dollar figures are shown on the official pricing page; all tiers require contacting sales, so this dossier's seed estimate (~$20,000/year for 10 seats on Foundations) comes from third-party procurement trackers, not a primary source, and is not repeated as fact here.

capabilities.en: Centralized content library for RFP, RFI and security-questionnaire responses.
AI-assisted automation to draft and populate tender/proposal answers from the content library.
Collaboration workflow for multiple contributors and reviewers on a single response project.

limitations.en: No self-serve free trial; access requires booking a demo with sales.
No public pricing at all, making budget comparison against competitors difficult without a sales conversation.

reason.en: Workflow and process documentation tool sometimes used to manage RFP checklists.
Knowledge base tool teams sometimes repurpose as a lightweight RFP content library.

missingAlternatives.name: Responsive (RFPIO)
missingAlternatives.reason: Direct, well-known RFP/proposal-response software competitor, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: No public dollar pricing found on the official pricing page for any tier (Foundations, Enhanced, Enterprise); all require a sales quote.
Minimum contract length and exact seat-pricing mechanics beyond the 10-seat Foundations starting point not confirmed on the official site.
